messages.content: 將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？

function.name: thermodynamics_calc_gas_pressure
function.description: Calculate gas pressure in a closed chamber due to heating Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

volume.description: The volume of the chamber in cubic meters. This is a float type value.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the gas in degree Celsius. This is a float type value.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the gas in degree Celsius. This is a float type value.

initial_pressure.description: The initial pressure of the gas in Pascal. Default is standard atmospheric pressure. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體?" They want how much gas will be produced? Actually they might mean what change in pressure occurs or maybe amount of gas molecules? But question says "will produce" which seems ambiguous. Probably they ask about increase in pressure inside the sealed room when heated from 25°C to 100°C.

We have tool to calculate gas pressure given volume and temperatures. We can use ideal gas law assuming constant moles. Use initial pressure default (standard atm ~101325 Pa). So we compute new pressure using proportionality with absolute temperature T_final/T_initial * P_initial. Convert temps to Kelvin: 298K -> 373K. Ratio 373/298 ≈1.2525. Multiply by 101325Pa gives approx 126800 Pa (~127 kPa).

Thus answer: Pressure increases to around 127kPa; difference ~26kPa above atmosphere. Or if asking quantity of gas produced, it's same as before because no chemical reaction. Might clarify.

Let's respond accordingly.
